power.method: 5V DC power adapter (100-240V AC input), 5.0V/1.0A output, USB-A adapter to USB-C camera connector

frigate.notes: go2rtc alternative: TP-Link's proprietary protocol via go2rtc (tapo://<tapo-account-password>@{ip}) is often more stable than RTSP (fewer timeouts / non-monotonic-timestamp errors). The password is your Tapo app/cloud account password — not the camera's RTSP/Device account — so all cameras on one account share it; only the IP changes. If non-monotonic-timestamp errors persist, disable audio for that camera in Frigate. Chrome may render the go2rtc live view with a squashed aspect ratio (a browser live-view quirk, not the stream); Firefox is correct.

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Must enable ONVIF in Tapo app.
